name: Mid-Century Modern Armchair
descriptions: Slim walnut legs and a gently curved wooden frame, inspired by 1950s design.
Button-tufted seat cushion with durable wool-blend upholstery in a bold accent color.
Comfortable for reading or an occasional lounge, balances vintage flair with everyday use.

name: Victorian Wingback Chair
descriptions: High-backed winged silhouette with carved mahogany legs and ornate detailing.
Deep seat and firm padding wrapped in brocade or damask fabric for a formal parlor feel.
Evokes late 19th-century elegance; sturdy and meant to be a focal piece of a room.

name: Art Deco Chaise Lounge
descriptions: Low, elongated seat with sweeping lines and geometric inlay accents.
Plush velvet upholstery and a single sloped arm make it ideal for reclining in style.
Reflects 1920s–1930s glamour; a dramatic statement piece for a living room or bedroom.

name: Scandinavian Minimalist Lounge Chair
descriptions: Clean lines, light oak frame, and a modestly padded neutral fabric seat.
Designed for simplicity and ergonomic comfort—fits well in modern, airy spaces.
Lightweight visual presence but built solidly for everyday seating.

name: Overstuffed Leather Club Chair
descriptions: Deep, enveloping seat with aged leather upholstery and rounded arms.
Dense cushioning and a low profile create a cozy, well-worn feel reminiscent of 1920s clubs.
Durable and comfortable—pairs well with a small side table and lamp.

name: Zero-Gravity Recliner
descriptions: Contemporary recliner with adjustable back and leg support for a near-weightless position.
Padded headrest, lumbar support, and a sturdy metal frame make it ideal for long relaxation.
Modern tech-friendly piece for living rooms or home theaters.

name: Rustic Farmhouse Rocking Chair
descriptions: Turned spindles, slightly weathered paint, and a gently curved rocker base.
Simple, sturdy construction meant for porches or cozy corners indoors.
Offers a soothing rocking motion and a handcrafted, country vibe.

name: Papasan Bowl Chair
descriptions: Large rattan bowl seat with a thick, removable cushion for a relaxed, bohemian look.
Deep, rounded seating that swivels slightly and cradles the sitter.
Casual and comfortable for lounging, reading, or a relaxed nap.

name: Beanbag Lounger
descriptions: Oversized, memory-foam filled beanbag with a wipeable outer cover.
Molds to the body for informal lounging; great in dens, dorms, or playrooms.
Casual, flexible seating that suits contemporary and youth-focused spaces.

name: Adirondack Outdoor Chair
descriptions: Slatted, low-slung wooden chair with angled back and wide armrests, designed for outdoor relaxation.
Typically made of weather-resistant wood or composite; suitable for patios, decks, and gardens.
Comfortable for long sits; the wide arms double as small surfaces for drinks or books.

name: Director's Folding Chair
descriptions: Canvas-seat chair with a lightweight wooden or metal X-frame and a simple, classic silhouette.
Portable-looking design that still functions as a casual indoor or outdoor seating piece.
Practical for short-term seating needs and adds a cinematic, utilitarian aesthetic.

name: Tufted Storage Ottoman
descriptions: Square padded ottoman with a tufted top and hidden interior storage for blankets or magazines.
Serves as a footrest, extra seating, or a low coffee-table surface depending on placement.
Classic upholstery finish that fits traditional and transitional interiors.

name: Mid-century walnut lounge chair
descriptions: Low-profile lounge chair with curved walnut frame and tapered legs, inspired by 1950s design.
Seat and back upholstered in dense foam with woven cotton or leather option; supportive but slightly reclined for reading.
Compact footprint (approximately 28in wide) suitable for living rooms or study corners; pairs well with a small ottoman.

name: Victorian tufted wingback
descriptions: High-backed wingchair with deep button tufting, rolled arms, and carved wooden legs — classic late-19th-century silhouette.
Generous padding and tall wings provide wind-shielded comfort near a fireplace or in a formal parlor.
Typically upholstered in heavy woven fabric or leather; substantial and ornate, needs a stable floor position.

name: Industrial metal-framed recliner
descriptions: Sturdy recliner with exposed steel frame, rivet details and distressed leather cushion for a workshop-to-loft look.
Mechanically reclining back and a pull-out footrest; designed for durability and heavy use.
Chunky presence and slightly angular lines make it suitable for industrial or rustic-modern interiors.

name: Scandinavian minimalist armchair
descriptions: Simple, light-framed armchair with pale wood legs and a gently contoured seat; emphasis on clean lines and function.
Medium-firm foam cushion covered in neutral linen; compact proportions work well in small apartments.
Designed to feel airy and calm — pairs with wooden coffee tables and soft textiles for a Nordic aesthetic.

name: Overstuffed sectional loveseat
descriptions: Plush two-seat sectional with deep seats, loose back cushions and overstuffed armrests for maximum comfort.
Upholstered in durable microfiber or chenille; modular pieces allow rearrangement into different layouts.
Large and soft — ideal for lounging, TV rooms, or family spaces that prioritize coziness.

name: Art Deco curved settee
descriptions: Elegant settee with sweeping curved back, low profile and geometric inlay details, reflecting 1920s glamour.
Usually upholstered in velvet or satin with brass or lacquered trim; visual centerpiece for an entry or parlor.
Compact seating for two; more decorative than heavily cushioned, best used as accent seating.

name: Zero-gravity modern recliner
descriptions: Ergonomic recliner designed to distribute weight evenly, often with multi-stage recline and lumbar support.
Sleek synthetic upholstery and hidden mechanisms for a contemporary look; sometimes includes small manual or electric controls.
Ideal for relaxation or recovery; moderate footprint and recommended to place near a power outlet if motorized.

name: Rattan outdoor chaise lounge
descriptions: Weather-resistant woven rattan chaise with adjustable backrest, designed for patios, poolside or sunrooms.
Foam cushion with removable cover for washing; lightweight but intended to remain stationary during use.
Natural texture fits informal outdoor settings and tropical or coastal design schemes.

name: Convertible sleeper sofa
descriptions: Two- or three-seater sofa with hidden pull-out mattress or fold-flat mechanism for occasional overnight guests.
Upholstery options vary from durable synthetics to mid-grade fabrics; cushions are firmer to accommodate conversion.
Space-saving multi-use furniture ideal for studio apartments or guest rooms.

name: Oversized bean bag chair
descriptions: Large, soft-filled seating that conforms to the sitter's shape; typically filled with polystyrene beads or shredded foam.
Casual, informal seating suited to lounges, game rooms or children's areas; cover zippered for cleaning.
Lightweight but considered furniture; best kept in a consistent spot to avoid scattering beads when opened.

name: Orthopedic recliner with footrest
descriptions: Chair engineered for back support with adjustable lumbar settings, dense cushioning and a built-in footrest.
Often used for recovery or by those with mobility needs; may include gentle lift assist in some models.
Sturdy construction and slightly larger footprint; positioned best in living areas where support is required.

name: Folding director's chair
descriptions: Lightweight folding seat with wooden frame and canvas seat/back; portable yet functions as occasional furniture.
Folds flat for storage or transport; preferred for temporary seating on patios or at events.
Simple, utilitarian aesthetic — not for long-term heavy use but convenient for extra guests.

name: Heirloom rocking chair
descriptions: Traditional wooden rocking chair with curved rockers, supportive slatted back and contoured seat.
Often crafted from oak or maple and finished with stain or paint; built to last generations and suitable for nurseries or porches.
Gentle rocking motion promotes relaxation; requires stable floor and appropriate spacing to rock freely.

name: Victorian Canopy Bed
descriptions: Ornately carved mahogany frame with a high headboard and four tall posts supporting a fabric canopy.
Heavy drapery and turned finials give it a 19th‑century, formal parlor feel—best for a room that leans traditional or historic.
Solid, stately presence that reads as luxurious and ceremonial rather than minimal or modern.

name: Mid‑Century Platform Bed
descriptions: Low‑profile platform with a long, linear headboard in warm teak tones and tapered legs.
Clean silhouette and minimal ornamentation reflect 1950s modern design—pairs well with simple textiles and graphic art.
Feels light and airy in a room, emphasizing horizontal planes and functional elegance.

name: Sleigh Bed (Empire Revival)
descriptions: Curved headboard and footboard reminiscent of French Empire and Federal styles, typically in polished cherry or walnut.
Robust, sculptural silhouette that brings warmth and a dramatic focal point to a bedroom.
Balances classic formality with the comfort of a substantial wooden frame.

name: Japanese Futon Platform Bed
descriptions: Very low wooden platform with slatted support and a streamlined pine finish, designed for futon or thin mattress use.
Minimalist, calming aesthetic influenced by traditional Japanese interiors—emphasizes floor proximity and openness.
Lightweight visual impact, suitable for small or zen‑inspired spaces.

name: Four‑Poster Farmstead Bed
descriptions: Constructed from reclaimed, rough‑hewn beams with simple mortise‑and‑tenon joinery for a rustic farmhouse feel.
Generous proportions and visible wood grain create a lived‑in, cozy appearance—ideal for country or cottage décors.
Sturdy and tactile, this bed reads as handcrafted and utilitarian with a warm patina.

name: Murphy Wall Bed
descriptions: Space‑saving bed that folds up into a shallow cabinet, finished in a neutral lacquer for modern apartments.
Mechanism is engineered for regular use; when closed it reads as shelving or a media unit—practical and efficient.
Ideal for multipurpose rooms or small footprints where floor space must be reclaimed during the day.

name: Industrial Iron Frame Bed
descriptions: Blackened wrought‑iron frame with exposed rivets and pipe‑like posts, channeling warehouse and factory aesthetics.
Simple slatted headboard and footboard create an honest, utilitarian look that pairs with raw materials like concrete and leather.
Feels sturdy and no‑nonsense—works well in lofts or eclectic interiors that mix metals with reclaimed wood.

name: Scandinavian Minimalist Bed
descriptions: Pale birch frame with simple slats, rounded corners, and an understated headboard—emphasizes light and functionality.
Designed for airy, clutter‑free bedrooms; aesthetic evokes hygge and natural materials.
Neutral and adaptable, it complements soft textiles and plants for a calm morning light feel.

name: Art Deco Upholstered Bed
descriptions: Velvet‑tufted headboard with geometric wood veneer details and brass inlay accents, channeling 1920s glamour.
Bold, stylish silhouette that serves as a statement piece—pairs with luxe textiles and mirrored or lacquered surfaces.
Feels opulent and theatrical, ideal for interiors seeking vintage glamour or boutique‑hotel vibes.

name: Storage Divan Bed
descriptions: Contemporary upholstered base with integrated drawers and lift‑top storage—practical for family bedrooms and small homes.
Neutral upholstery and compact profile make it versatile; built to maximize under‑bed space without sacrificing comfort.
Functional, modern, and designed around everyday convenience rather than decorative flourish.

name: large bed
descriptions: A large, comfortable bed with clean sheets.
